<!-- Generated by pnpm run docgen. Do not edit directly. -->

Scripts export a CommonJS generator function and receive one context object.

```js
module.exports = function* run({ api, autoZone, autoRelogin }) {
  api.log("started")
  yield* api.player.joinMap("battleon")
}
```

## Context

| Member | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [`api`](./api/) | Core game and service APIs, grouped by namespace. |
| [`autoZone`](./auto-zone/) | Auto Zone feature controls. |
| [`autoRelogin`](./auto-relogin/) | Auto Relogin feature controls. |
